chunks: We raised over you seven firm (skies)
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'seven firm skies'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cosmic order (Nizam) as a testament to Allah's absolute sovereignty, with the 'seven firm heavens' often interpreted through the lens of the Twelve Imams as the spiritual pillars sustaining the universe. The term 'Shidad' (strong/firm) underscores the structural integrity of the celestial realms, serving as a macrocosmic reflection of the microcosmic guidance provided by the Ahl al-Bayt.
